title: Minot launch signal stopped by inhibit switch
place_text: Minot Air Force Base, North Dakota

tellings.quote: Robert Hastings did a phone interview with Captain David Sher who actually received a launch indicator at his man post

plain: Podcast host Jesse Michels, in a 2024 episode with Robert Hastings, a researcher who collects accounts of UFOs at nuclear bases, recounts a 1966 incident at Minot Air Force Base in North Dakota, a base with nuclear missiles. He says Hastings interviewed by phone a Captain David Sher, who received a launch indicator, a signal that a missile was starting to launch, at his post, and that it was stopped by an inhibit switch, a safety control. It is told as part of the claim that UFOs have been watching and interfering with nuclear weapons.
